name: Group Header 104
definition: Set of characteristics shared by all individual instructions included in the message.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Point to point reference, as assigned by the instructing agent, and sent to the market infrastructure to unambiguously identify the message.||Usage: The instructing agent has to make sure that MessageIdentification is unique per market infrastructure for a pre-agreed period.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the message was created.

NumberOfSettlementRequests.name: Number Of Settlement Requests
NumberOfSettlementRequests.definition: Number of individual settlement requests contained in the message.

ControlSum.name: Control Sum
ControlSum.definition: Total of all individual amounts included in the message, irrespective of currencies.

SettlementInformation.name: Settlement Information
SettlementInformation.definition: Specifies the details on how the settlement of the transaction(s) between the instructing agent and the market infrastructure is completed.
